## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sampakkhandanalakkhaṇasaddhāpañha* ("The Question on Aspiration", Mil 3.1.11) is a doctrinal dialogue in the *Milindapañha*. It addresses the characteristic of faith (*saddhā*) as aspiration or striving forward (*sampakkhandana-lakkhaṇa*), forming a conceptual pair with the preceding section on faith as serene clarity (*sampasādana-lakkhaṇa*, Mil 3.1.10). It has been translated into English by John Kelly.

 Related verses and passages on faith are also noted in connection with the *Āḷavaka Sutta* (SN 10.12 / Snp 1.10), Sanskrit and Tibetan recensions of the *Udānavarga* (UV 10, UVS 10, Uv Kg 10), Chinese parallels (T 210.4, T 212.11, T 213.10), and the *Śarīrārthagāthā*.

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog data.*
